--- webview-ui/src/office/engine/gameLoop.ts lines 9-36 ---
https://github.com/pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents/blob/d1e007a9fdf3003c252d2973abe1999ae59aec33/webview-ui/src/office/engine/gameLoop.ts#L9-L36
9: export function startGameLoop(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, callbacks: GameLoopCallbacks): () => void {
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!;
11:   ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
12: 
13:   let lastTime = 0;
14:   let rafId = 0;
15:   let stopped = false;
16: 
17:   const frame = (time: number) => {
18:     if (stopped) return;
19:     const dt = lastTime === 0 ? 0 : Math.min((time - lastTime) / 1000, MAX_DELTA_TIME_SEC);
20:     lastTime = time;
21: 
22:     callbacks.update(dt);
23: 
24:     ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
25:     callbacks.render(ctx);
26: 
27:     rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
28:   };
29: 
30:   rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
31: 
32:   return () => {
33:     stopped = true;
34:     cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
35:   };
36: }

--- webview-ui/src/office/layout/tileMap.ts lines 37-105 ---
https://github.com/pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents/blob/d1e007a9fdf3003c252d2973abe1999ae59aec33/webview-ui/src/office/layout/tileMap.ts#L37-L105
37: /** BFS pathfinding on 4-connected grid (no diagonals). Returns path excluding start, including end. */
38: export function findPath(
39:   startCol: number,
40:   startRow: number,
41:   endCol: number,
42:   endRow: number,
43:   tileMap: TileType[][],
44:   blockedTiles: Set<string>,
45: ): Array<{ col: number; row: number }> {
46:   if (startCol === endCol && startRow === endRow) return [];
47: 
48:   const key = (c: number, r: number) => `${c},${r}`;
49:   const startKey = key(startCol, startRow);
50:   const endKey = key(endCol, endRow);
51: 
52:   // End must be walkable (or be a chair tile which may be adjacent to desk)
53:   // We allow the end tile even if it's not strictly walkable for chair positions
54:   const endWalkable = isWalkable(endCol, endRow, tileMap, blockedTiles);
55:   if (!endWalkable) {
56:     // If the end is a desk tile, we still can't path there
57:     return [];
58:   }
59: 
60:   const visited = new Set<string>();
61:   visited.add(startKey);
62: 
63:   const parent = new Map<string, string>();
64:   const queue: Array<{ col: number; row: number }> = [{ col: startCol, row: startRow }];
65: 
66:   const dirs = [
67:     { dc: 0, dr: -1 }, // up
68:     { dc: 0, dr: 1 }, // down
69:     { dc: -1, dr: 0 }, // left
70:     { dc: 1, dr: 0 }, // right
71:   ];
72: 
73:   while (queue.length > 0) {
74:     const curr = queue.shift()!;
75:     const currKey = key(curr.col, curr.row);
76: 
77:     if (currKey === endKey) {
78:       // Reconstruct path
79:       const path: Array<{ col: number; row: number }> = [];
80:       let k = endKey;
81:       while (k !== startKey) {
82:         const [c, r] = k.split(',').map(Number);
83:         path.unshift({ col: c, row: r });
84:         k = parent.get(k)!;
85:       }
86:       return path;
87:     }
88: 
89:     for (const d of dirs) {
90:       const nc = curr.col + d.dc;
91:       const nr = curr.row + d.dr;
92:       const nk = key(nc, nr);
93: 
94:       if (visited.has(nk)) continue;
95:       if (!isWalkable(nc, nr, tileMap, blockedTiles)) continue;
96: 
97:       visited.add(nk);
98:       parent.set(nk, currKey);
99:       queue.push({ col: nc, row: nr });
100:     }
101:   }
102: 
103:   // No path found
104:   return [];
105: }

--- webview-ui/src/office/engine/characters.ts lines 26-47 ---
https://github.com/pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents/blob/d1e007a9fdf3003c252d2973abe1999ae59aec33/webview-ui/src/office/engine/characters.ts#L26-L47
26: /** Pixel center of a tile */
27: function tileCenter(col: number, row: number): { x: number; y: number } {
28:   return {
29:     x: col * TILE_SIZE + TILE_SIZE / 2,
30:     y: row * TILE_SIZE + TILE_SIZE / 2,
31:   };
32: }
33: 
34: /** Direction from one tile to an adjacent tile */
35: function directionBetween(
36:   fromCol: number,
37:   fromRow: number,
38:   toCol: number,
39:   toRow: number,
40: ): Direction {
41:   const dc = toCol - fromCol;
42:   const dr = toRow - fromRow;
43:   if (dc > 0) return Direction.RIGHT;
44:   if (dc < 0) return Direction.LEFT;
45:   if (dr > 0) return Direction.DOWN;
46:   return Direction.UP;
47: }

--- webview-ui/src/office/engine/characters.ts lines 271-291 ---
https://github.com/pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents/blob/d1e007a9fdf3003c252d2973abe1999ae59aec33/webview-ui/src/office/engine/characters.ts#L271-L291
271:       // Move toward next tile in path
272:       const nextTile = ch.path[0];
273:       ch.dir = directionBetween(ch.tileCol, ch.tileRow, nextTile.col, nextTile.row);
274: 
275:       ch.moveProgress += (WALK_SPEED_PX_PER_SEC / TILE_SIZE) * dt;
276: 
277:       const fromCenter = tileCenter(ch.tileCol, ch.tileRow);
278:       const toCenter = tileCenter(nextTile.col, nextTile.row);
279:       const t = Math.min(ch.moveProgress, 1);
280:       ch.x = fromCenter.x + (toCenter.x - fromCenter.x) * t;
281:       ch.y = fromCenter.y + (toCenter.y - fromCenter.y) * t;
282: 
283:       if (ch.moveProgress >= 1) {
284:         // Arrived at next tile
285:         ch.tileCol = nextTile.col;
286:         ch.tileRow = nextTile.row;
287:         ch.x = toCenter.x;
288:         ch.y = toCenter.y;
289:         ch.path.shift();
290:         ch.moveProgress = 0;
291:       }

--- webview-ui/src/office/sprites/spriteCache.ts lines 3-3 ---
https://github.com/pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents/blob/d1e007a9fdf3003c252d2973abe1999ae59aec33/webview-ui/src/office/sprites/spriteCache.ts#L3-L3

--- webview-ui/src/office/sprites/spriteCache.ts lines 48-77 ---
https://github.com/pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents/blob/d1e007a9fdf3003c252d2973abe1999ae59aec33/webview-ui/src/office/sprites/spriteCache.ts#L48-L77
48: export function getCachedSprite(sprite: SpriteData, zoom: number): HTMLCanvasElement {
49:   let cache = zoomCaches.get(zoom);
50:   if (!cache) {
51:     cache = new WeakMap();
52:     zoomCaches.set(zoom, cache);
53:   }
54: 
55:   const cached = cache.get(sprite);
56:   if (cached) return cached;
57: 
58:   const rows = sprite.length;
59:   const cols = sprite[0].length;
60:   const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
61:   canvas.width = cols * zoom;
62:   canvas.height = rows * zoom;
63:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!;
64:   ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
65: 
66:   for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
67:     for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
68:       const color = sprite[r][c];
69:       if (color === '') continue;
70:       ctx.fillStyle = color;
71:       ctx.fillRect(c * zoom, r * zoom, zoom, zoom);
72:     }
73:   }
74: 
75:   cache.set(sprite, canvas);
76:   return canvas;
77: }
